## Reading the count

This is the gate run on the corpus as it stands, not a phase decision:
- **Three entries, not a seed corpus.** The corpus holds the three Phase-0 entries. 13 §1.2
  estimates roughly 25–45 gate-passing entries at the 320-entry seed and 120–210 at maturity, and
  13 §3.2 expects the ≥ 70 threshold to go unmet at seed scale. A count of 0 from three records
  confirms nothing about either figure.
- **Clauses 4 and 5 cannot pass anything yet.** The facts they read, the dangerous-capability
  carve-out (13 §5.6) and coverage by a maintained harness leaderboard, are not schema fields: 04
  owns them and has not added them. Every record that reaches clause 4 is therefore undetermined;
  SWE-bench is the one that did. That is the gate declining to guess, not SWE-bench failing it.
- **CASP stopped on a missing fact, not a failing one.** Its `reproducibility_tier` is not curated
  (null), so it is undetermined at clause 1. RoboArena fails clause 1 on its stated
  `requires-specialized-hardware`.
